Defer the new parser, bridge and passthrough wiring together: truncated invocations and literal code examples synthesize executable tool calls; generated events violate sequence/index/identity, while partial tags bypass the buffer cap. The passthrough hook is unreachable for normal DeepSeek platform accounts and additionally breaks SSE frame boundaries, final output identities, and preauthorization observation. Preserve existing think/thinking conversion and native structured tools until provider-scoped parsing and real Forward-level streaming/billing regressions are available. The standard library HTTP2Config has no independent idle timeout; upstream assigns the h2c timeout to Server.IdleTimeout and changes HTTP/1 connection lifetime. Preserve the existing x/net server setup until separate HTTP/1 and h2c timeout behavior can be retained. The outbound standard library HTTP/2 transport update is imported.

Preserve the existing entry platform and image-generation permission rejection until resolved-target authorization and auditing are covered; duplicate-model rejection is imported independently.
